text.p: A stake of 10 million shares in Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom sold at auction on Wednesday at an average 2,180.25 roubles ($0.398) a share, down from 2,182.32 roubles at the previous auction on November 5, the Federal Securities Corporation (FFK) said.
Since auctions began in March 1996, 231.00 million shares, equivalent to 0.98 percent of the capital, have changed hands, the FFK said.
Prices have risen from an average 406.60 roubles a share at the first auction on March 6.
Gazprom is one of Russia's biggest companies by market capitalisation but its 23.6 billion shares are highly illiquid because of company restrictions on selling them.
The company has organised the auctions to create an orderly market in its paper.
Gazprom was $0.40 at 1440 GMT on Wednesday on the Russian Trading System, down from $0.41 at Tuesday's close.
Its American Depositary Shares in London were $17.75 after $17.73. One ADS is equivalent to 10 ordinary shares.

The next auction will be held on November 20, when 10 million shares in 40 lots will be offered at a starting price of 2,071 roubles a share. Further auctions will be held on November 27, December 4, 11 and 18.
